profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at ActivTrak
profile.summary:
I have over 12 years of experience working in software engineering and I'm very passionate on how technology has shaped the way we do business and simplified our day to day life.

I'm interested in all levels of the software engineering discipline and have been fortunate to be exposed to different areas already. Started my career testing and developing on low level embedded systems using C and C++, moved to data analytics and now I have been moving back and forth between Java/C#/Python based back ends for Web Services and front end development using JavaScript(React, Angular), HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Lead Consultant
positions.description:
Developed MicroStrategy and Tableau custom integrations to portals, using React JS, Material UI, Webpack and the JavaScript embedding APIs of each BI platform. 

Created customized scripts for automated deployments of MicroStrategy servers and projects to AWS. 

Implemented solutions using the MicroStrategy Java SDK & Python to automate object creation; integrate into customer authentication solutions; and facilitate migrations.

positions.title: Senior Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
- Work with JavaScript/HTML5/CSS in support and enhancement of the Desktop/Visual Insight application.
- Worked in the rewrite and redesign of Enterprise Manager, using Java, C++ and SQL
- Worked with Java to provide support and maintenance to current products of the MicroStrategy software. 
- Develop an internal tool in Java to help streamline the build process for the configuration management team

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
- Provided solutions to customer issues using the MicroStrategy software suite.
- Worked as the point of contact to resolve issues related to the SQL generation engine. 
- Reproduced and reported bugs and worked as the communication channel between the customer and the engineering team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked in the graphics driver test team as a contractor for Texas Instruments. This work included: running the test suite, updating reports, debugging and fixing the driver code and porting test applications to run on top of mobile operative systems.
